# Kronos Fusion Energy — /investors

> 3 pages. Design-and-simulation stage; open, no economics.

- [Investors](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/investors/): Kronos Fusion Energy — investment thesis, approach, and milestones. Design-and-simulation stage; not an offer of securit
- [Milestones — Investors](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/investors/milestones.html): The Kronos plan: construction from Q2 2027, first-of-a-kind ~2030, test burner ~2032, commercial fleet ~2036.
- [The Approach — Investors](https://kronosfusionenergy.com/investors/the-approach.html): How Kronos de-risks fusion: simulation-first, products on the path to power, breeder-first, open and honest.
